evidence.quote: You will earn additional rewards in the U.S. restaurant category when you make a purchase at restaurants located in the U.S.
Whether you dine in or take out, treat yourself to more cash back on dining purchases when you let someone else do the cooking.
This category's merchants’ primary business is sit-down or eat-in dining, including fast food restaurants and fine dining establishments.
Includes purchases at cafes, bars, lounges, fast-food restaurants, restaurant delivery services, and take out restaurants.
Restaurant purchases include those made at merchants classified as full-service restaurants, cafes, cafeterias, fast-food locations, and caterers.
Let someone else do the cooking while you earn cash back at cafes, cafeterias, grills and fine-dining establishments.

draft.notes: The site is primarily a restaurant ordering business, so physicalGoods is false under the stated rule. Some issuer terms exclude bakeries or caterers, and the page lists Bakery and Catering, but its broader menu supports dining.
